title: Integral projection commutes with one proper compactification refinement
statement: Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum of [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. The schemes are finite-type schemes over its field, with separated finite-type morphisms [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Compactifications and proper refinements are those of [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let $S$ be the normalized six-functor operation datum and assume $\ell$ is invertible in the base field. At the integral stage $\mathcal O_E$, with the completed tensor and pullback, $\mathrm{refinementLaw}(S_{\mathrm{int}},\otimes^{\wedge},\mathrm{PF}_{\mathrm{int}},P)$ of [def-sf-projection-single-refinement-law] holds, where $P_Y(L)$ is the uniform finite-reduction Tor predicate [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Thus the displayed projection square holds for one supplied proper refinement and all bounded constructible $K$, without a Tor assumption on $K$, and all $L$ in that finite-Tor domain. It makes no assertion for a pair of unrelated compactifications.

Faithfulness of the full-subcategory inclusion yields PF_d followed by rho inverse = tensor(rho inverse) followed by PF_c in the operation category.

theorem integralRefinementProjection
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (C : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (S : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (hl : IsUnit (C.l : D.k)) :
    refinementLaw S.higher.integral S.higher.integralTensor S.higher.integralExchange
      (fun Y K ↦ finiteTorConstructibleIntegral C.l E Y.obj.left K.obj)
